title: Jalen Hurts: It's about meeting the moment when opportunity comes

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jalen Hurts: It's about meeting the moment when opportunity comes
sources.description: There were some long stretches during Sunday's game when the Eagles offense failed to click, including five three-and-outs in 11 total possessions, but they were able to beat the Commanders because of big plays that got sprinkled throughout the contest.
